title: Good and bad possibilities
hook: Two stated cases: explore the direction and weight of a belief update.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the direction and weight of a belief update affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Posterior, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the direction and weight of a belief update in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
